name: InstallJeopardyManager
tagline: Catch failing broadband and fibre install appointments before the truck rolls.
description: A complete jeopardy desk for telecom install appointments in one Power Apps code component: risk scores from router/CPE logistics, access confirmation, weather, network readiness, permits and re-book history; a ranked risk queue with one-click fixes; a 7-day schedule with daily capacity and drag-to-re-book; enforced re-book rules; and first-time-right analytics. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Jeopardy risk score 0-100 with drivers and recommended fixes
Pre-install checklist: CPE, access, network, permit, weather, technician
Re-book rules: window, no-access contact attempts, weather alerts, CPE lead time, vulnerable customers, supervisor approval, daily capacity
Drag or Shift+arrow re-booking on the schedule
Bulk assign, flag, confirm, cancel and CSV export with undo
First-time-right by product, technician and patch
controlType: standard (2 controls: InstallJeopardyManager data-set + InstallJeopardyManagerPortal field)
